abstract:
A Euclidean Jordan algebra is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space carrying a commutative bilinear product with a unit, satisfying the Jordan identity (x*y)*(x*x) = x*(y*(x*x)) and the associativity of the inner product <x*y, z> = <y, x*z>. This is Faraut-Koranyi's definition (Analysis on Symmetric Cones, III.1). This development formalizes the classical structure theory of these algebras.
Mathlib carries the Jordan identity as the typeclass IsCommJordan together with five operator-commutation lemmas, and nothing beyond that: no idempotent theory, no Peirce decomposition, no spectral theory. This development supplies that layer.
The registered results, in four separate Comparator configurations. (1) The Koecher / Alfsen-Shultz theorem: a unital linear order isomorphism of a Euclidean Jordan algebra is a Jordan automorphism, with the cone taken to be the sums-of-squares cone and the product carried as a bundled bilinear map so that the statement needs no ring instance to elaborate. (2) The single-element spectral theorem: every element of a finite-dimensional formally real Jordan algebra is a real linear combination of a complete family of pairwise-orthogonal idempotents. Finite-dimensionality is load-bearing rather than decorative - the polynomial algebra R[X] satisfies every other hypothesis and has no nonconstant spectral resolution. (3) The Jordan trace form tau(x,y) = tr(L_{x*y}): symmetric, associative, and positive definite, constructed from the multiplication alone rather than assumed. Symmetry and associativity are registered at their honest generality, which does not include finite-dimensionality; positive definiteness needs the spectral theorem and therefore does. (4) The frame Peirce decomposition: for a Jordan frame p_1, ..., p_n the algebra is the internal direct sum of the blocks V_ij over unordered pairs, together with the Faraut-Koranyi table entry dim V_ii = 1.
Direction and scope. Every registered theorem is proved outright from the stated hypotheses; none is conditional on a cited result. The development also proves, but does not register here, Albert's power-associativity theorem (x^(m+1) * x^(n+1) = x^(m+n+2), with no unit, finite dimension, formal reality or positivity assumed), which is registered from a separate development of the author's and is deliberately not re-registered; the existence of a Jordan frame in any nontrivial finite-dimensional Euclidean Jordan algebra; the associativity of the subalgebra generated by a single element; the Peirce subalgebras J_2(c) and J_0(c) as Euclidean Jordan algebras in their own right; and an order-unit-space structure with the sums-of-squares cone, proved to coincide with the Loewner order on the concrete carrier.
What is NOT here. Coordinatization is absent: the Jordan-von Neumann-Wigner route continues by making the off-diagonal block a composition algebra and applying Hurwitz's theorem to land J = H_n(K), and that step depends on the composition-algebra classification, which lives in a separate repository. This development therefore stops at the connectors and the frame-block structure. There is no functional calculus on the spectral resolution. Frame conjugacy (Faraut-Koranyi IV.2.5) is not proved - the development sidesteps it by carrying a Jordan frame as data rather than reasoning about the rank as a number. The classification of simple Euclidean Jordan algebras is not proved, and no statement about the exceptional algebra H_3(O) appears. Formal reality and the associativity of the inner product are equivalent over R in finite dimension, but that equivalence is not formalized, so both appear as hypotheses.
The abstract theory has a live carrier: H_n(K) for K = R or C, the Hermitian matrices under A*B = (AB+BA)/2, is an instance of the EuclideanJordanAlgebra class, checked by instance synthesis in the mechanical audit rather than by inspection. The check is finer than nonemptiness of the class: every Peirce rule mentioning the half-eigenspace would be vacuously true on a carrier where that space is trivial, and it is trivial for the two idempotents one reaches for first, so a witness with nonzero half-eigenspace is exhibited on H_2(C).
Every declaration in the tracked tree has an axiom closure contained in Lean's three core axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). The tree carries no custom axiom, no sorry and no native_decide.

related_formalizations.note: Seventeen modules (Hermitian matrices with the Loewner order, trace inner product, continuous functional calculus, Jordan product) by Alex Meiburg, with HermitianMat/Proj.lean also by Leonardo A Lessa, vendored at commit a50684a191 under EuclideanJordan/Vendor/ with per-file copyright headers retained. They form the concrete carrier H_n(K) on which the abstract class is shown to be inhabited. The modules match that upstream pin except for two documented mechanical edits, an import-path rewrite and one restored set_option; the edit log is in EuclideanJordan/Vendor/VENDOR.md. The vendored modules are inside the audited tree, so the axiom census runs over every declaration in them.

Mathlib supplies IsCommJordan (commutativity plus the Jordan identity) and five operator-commutation lemmas, plus the linear algebra, polynomial ideal theory and trace machinery the proofs run on. It carries no idempotent theory, no Peirce decomposition and no Jordan spectral theory; that is what this development adds. The Mathlib-facing upstream shape for Albert's theorem is the existing PNatPowAssoc class, and transporting jpow_mul_jpow across it is not done here.
